patterns.message: core/ is the reusable layer: it must not import from app/, the route tree. Move the shared file into core/ instead.

paths.name: @makeplane/propel/icons
paths.message: Import icons from @pace/propel/icons, which re-exports this set alongside the in-repo icons, so a call site never has to know which set an icon came from. apps/web joins this rule once the pull request that deletes its last 15 users of the old path has landed; apps/admin cannot, because it declares no @pace/propel dependency.
